references.text: The same expression 'קְרִיאֵי מוֹעֵד' (called to the assembly) is used of the leaders who rose up against Moses
Describes the same tribal princes (נְשִׂיאֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל) who brought offerings
Refers to the same twelve tribal princes who were mustered together with Moses and Aaron
Moses' father-in-law Jethro suggested appointing 'leaders over thousands' (שָׂרֵי אֲלָפִים), which corresponds to 'heads of Israel's thousands' (רָאשֵׁי אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵL)
The princes (נְשִׂיאִים) who were heads of Israel's thousands were to gather at the sound of the trumpet
Lists the same tribal princes by name who were to lead each tribe's camp
Uses the same terminology for tribal princes (נָשִׂיא) as leaders over their fathers' houses
The expression 'leaders over thousands in Israel' (אַלְפֵי יִשְׂרָאֵL) is used of Israel's leaders
